text:
This photo shows a mostly finished meal. The leftovers are:
- Scrambled egg residue on the large plate, roughly 10 g.
- A small butter or margarine cup that looks full, roughly 7 g.
- Coffee residue in the mug, about 20 g of milky coffee.
- Crumbs on the small plate, about 2 g.

Energy estimate:
- Egg residue: about 10 g at 1.5 kcal/g, so about 15 kcal.
- Butter: about 7 g at 7.2 kcal/g, so about 50 kcal.
- Coffee: about 20 g at 0.3 kcal/g, so about 6 kcal.
- Crumbs: about 2 g at 3 kcal/g, so about 6 kcal.

That comes to about 77 kcal and 39 g, which I rounded to 75 kcal and 40 g.
